key.name: jira-site
key.summary: Jira Cloud site

key.name: jira-email
key.summary: Jira account email

key.name: jira-token
key.summary: Jira API token (NOT your password)

key.name: clockify-api-key
key.summary: Clockify API key (Profile -> Settings -> API)

key.name: clockify-workspace-id
key.summary: Resolved Clockify workspace id (auto-filled)

key.name: clockify-user-id
key.summary: Resolved Clockify user id (auto-filled)

key.name: clockify-default-project-id
key.summary: Project preselected in the new-entry modal and used by the Jira->Clockify sync

key.name: clockify-billable-default
key.summary: Default value of the billable toggle on new Clockify entries

key.name: worklog-source
key.summary: Which calendar source to render

key.name: daily-target-hours
key.summary: Daily target hours used for the per-day totals diff

key.name: show-issue-summary
key.summary: Append the issue title after the key on each Jira block

key.name: issue-jql
key.default: 'assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC'
key.summary: JQL used to populate the issue picker in the new-worklog modal

key.name: issue-max
key.summary: Max issues to show in the picker

key.name: show-bottom-panel
key.summary: Show the rings / subtasks / heatmap panel below the calendar

key.name: bottom-view
key.summary: Which bottom-panel view to show

key.name: show-subtask-table
key.summary: Enable the subtask-table view in the bottom panel

key.name: subtask-jql
key.default: 'issuetype in subTaskIssueTypes() AND assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC'
key.summary: JQL that drives the subtask table

key.name: subtask-show-parent
key.summary: Show the parent-issue column in the subtask table

key.name: sprint-strategy
key.summary: How to discover the active sprint

key.name: sprint-field
key.summary: Jira issue field holding the sprint array

key.name: sprint-board-id
key.summary: Board id used by the agile-board strategy

key.name: remaining-mode
key.summary: How to compute remaining hours (api vs originalEstimate - timeSpent)

key.name: popup-width
key.summary: Floating popup width in pixels

key.name: popup-height
key.summary: Floating popup height in pixels

key.name: window-width
key.summary: Main application window width

key.name: window-height
key.summary: Main application window height

key.name: run-in-background
key.summary: Keep running in the background (tray) when windows are closed

key.name: show-tray-icon
key.summary: Show the top-bar clock indicator

key.name: debug
key.summary: Log every Jira/Clockify request to stdout
